commission_route.goal: Switch on the power path at the table
commission_route.why: The Sun gives more power than the battery can hold
commission_route.result: Power path on. Extra sunlight now has a use.
commission_route.hint: Follow the line from the solar panels to the battery.

commission_result.goal: Check what happened at the table
commission_result.why: See if the extra power was used or lost
commission_result.result: Checked. Power you use counts. Power that spills is lost.
commission_result.hint: Compare the power made with the power the battery kept.

charter_card.goal: Read the safety card on the wall
charter_card.why: These rules keep all four of you safe
charter_card.result: Safety card read. You know the rules now.
charter_card.hint: The card is on the wall near the Mission Table.

classify_information.goal: Sort the facts at the control desk
classify_information.why: Some facts still work when Earth cannot call
classify_information.result: Sorted. You know which facts work without Earth.
classify_information.hint: Ask of each one: do we still have it if Earth is silent?

roll_call.goal: Count your crew at the board
roll_call.why: Four names on the board means nobody is lost
roll_call.result: Everyone is here. All four cadets counted.
roll_call.hint: Each name tag on the board is one person.

practice_fault.goal: Fix the practice problem at the desk
practice_fault.why: Practise fixing things with no help from Earth
practice_fault.result: Practice problem fixed with no help from Earth.
practice_fault.hint: Use only the facts you sorted as ours.

calibrate_probe.goal: Test the water meter in dry soil
calibrate_probe.why: A meter must be tested before you trust it
calibrate_probe.hint: Dry soil first. Wet soil comes next.

span_probe.goal: Test the water meter in wet soil
span_probe.why: Now the meter knows both dry and wet
span_probe.hint: Wet soil is the second test.

recheck_probe.goal: Test the meter again, dry then wet
recheck_probe.why: A second test proves the meter is right
recheck_probe.result: The meter is right. You can trust it.
recheck_probe.hint: Do dry first, then wet, the same as before.

inspect_packet.goal: Look at the old seed packet
inspect_packet.why: Someone wrote on it long before you came
inspect_packet.result: Packet checked. You did not open it.
inspect_packet.hint: Only look and take notes. Do not open it.

compare_atmosphere.goal: Compare the two plant room pictures
compare_atmosphere.why: The old cotton test had a different goal
compare_atmosphere.result: Compared. Both rooms hold air. The goals are different.
compare_atmosphere.hint: Both rooms keep air inside. Look at what each is for.

plant_alo.goal: Plant Alo's seed using the gloves
plant_alo.why: Alo grows in a sealed box outside the garden
plant_alo.result: Alo is planted in the outside box.
plant_alo.hint: Reach in with the gloves. The box stays closed.

plant_tara.goal: Plant Tara's seed inside the garden
plant_tara.why: Tara grows indoors so you can compare her with Alo
plant_tara.result: Tara is planted in the indoor box.
plant_tara.hint: Plant her just like Alo, but indoors.

water_alo.goal: Water Alo until the meter is green
water_alo.why: Too little water and Alo dries out
water_alo.result: Alo has the right amount of water.
water_alo.hint: Watch the meter, not the water.

water_tara.goal: Water Tara until the meter is green
water_tara.why: Both plants must get the same care
water_tara.result: Tara has the right amount of water.
water_tara.hint: Give Tara the same water as Alo.

label_alo.goal: Put the Outside test label on Alo
label_alo.why: A label tells everyone which plant is which
label_alo.result: Alo's box is labelled Outside test.
label_alo.hint: The label says what the plant is for.

label_tara.goal: Put the Indoor label on Tara
label_tara.why: Tara is the plant you compare Alo with
label_tara.hint: Tara is the indoor plant you compare with.

seal_alo.goal: Close the lid on Alo's box
seal_alo.why: A closed lid keeps Alo's air and water in
seal_alo.hint: Check the lid all the way round.

seal_tara.goal: Close the lid on Tara's box
seal_tara.why: Tara gets the same closed lid as Alo

record_paired_conditions.why: First-day notes let you see every change later
record_paired_conditions.result: Day-one notes and photos saved for both plants.
record_paired_conditions.hint: For each plant: date, light, water and a photo.

confirm_services.goal: Check both boxes get light, air, water
confirm_services.why: Plants need all three to live
confirm_services.result: Light, air and water reach both boxes.
confirm_services.hint: Follow each pipe from the service room to the box.

test_hand_light.goal: Test the hand lamp and hang it up
test_hand_light.why: Alo needs a light the crew can carry
test_hand_light.result: Hand lamp works. It is hung up.
test_hand_light.hint: Switch it on to test it first.

care_montage.goal: Write down each visit to Alo
care_montage.why: Each visit teaches you one more thing about Alo
care_montage.result: Visits saved, each with its date.
care_montage.hint: One note per visit. Dates matter.

confirm_date_transition.goal: Move the date on at the power panel
confirm_date_transition.why: It becomes 25 April, the last day of sunlight
confirm_date_transition.result: It is now 25 April 2046. Two sunny shifts are left.
confirm_date_transition.hint: The date only changes when you press it.

arrange_timeline.goal: Put the three time lines in order
arrange_timeline.why: Sunset, losing Earth and base jobs come at different times
arrange_timeline.result: Times in order. Sunset and losing Earth are separate.
arrange_timeline.hint: Sunset does not stop everything at once.

ack_schedule.why: Everyone has a job to finish before dark
ack_schedule.result: Plan read. Everyone knows their job before dark.
ack_schedule.hint: See whose job must finish before another starts.

role_cards.why: They tell you how much power and air is safe
role_cards.result: Notes read. You know the power and air limits.
role_cards.hint: Two notes: Kai on power, Amara on air.

p02_shift1.goal: Plan shift 1 at the power panel
p02_shift1.why: The Sun sets in two shifts. Save what you can.
p02_shift1.hint: Make air now, while sunlight is free.

p02_stage_shift2.why: Do not lock it yet. The shelter drill comes first.
p02_stage_shift2.result: Shift 2 is tried, not locked. The drill is next.
p02_stage_shift2.hint: Press Try it only. Nothing changes yet.

shelter_drill.goal: Practise the shelter drill at the board
shelter_drill.why: A storm gives minutes. Practice makes you fast.
shelter_drill.result: Drill done. Going in and counting cost nothing.
shelter_drill.hint: Go in, close the door, count the crew.

verify_drill_baseline.why: A practice must not use up real supplies
verify_drill_baseline.hint: Compare the numbers with the ones before the drill.

p02_shift2.goal: Lock in shift 2 at the control desk
p02_shift2.why: Sunset is at 18:00. This is the last sunny shift.
p02_shift2.result: Shift 2 locked in at 18:00. The night begins.
p02_shift2.hint: Get the shelter ready before the alarm.

combine_cards.goal: Put Mei's and Rafi's notes together
combine_cards.why: Plants and the storm shield share the same water
combine_cards.result: Notes joined. Plants and the shield share one water tank.
combine_cards.hint: Which two facts change the water plan?

ack_earth_set.goal: Read when the Earth call ends
ack_earth_set.why: After that the crew decides alone until sunrise
ack_earth_set.result: Read. Until sunrise the crew decides without Earth.
ack_earth_set.hint: The call ends in shift 4. Plan without it.

p02_shifts3_4.why: No sunlight now. Each shift uses battery and air.

confirm_four_sheltered.goal: Count four crew inside the shelter
confirm_four_sheltered.why: A real Sun storm is coming. Nobody stays outside.
confirm_four_sheltered.result: All four are safe behind the water wall.
confirm_four_sheltered.hint: Count the name tags on the board.

p02_shift5_alarm.goal: Answer the storm alarm at the desk
p02_shift5_alarm.why: Wait, pump water or stack boxes. Choose one.
p02_shift5_alarm.result: Alarm answered. All four stay safe while the storm passes.
p02_shift5_alarm.hint: Press Try it to see if waiting is safe.

verify_exposure_order.goal: Check the storm score before moving water
verify_exposure_order.why: The water protects you. Check before you take it away.
verify_exposure_order.result: Storm score checked before moving the water.
verify_exposure_order.hint: Check first. Move the water second.

return_water.goal: Give the water back to the garden
return_water.why: The garden lent its water. Alo is thirsty.
return_water.result: Water is back in the garden.
return_water.hint: Give it back only after the storm score is checked.

p02_shifts6_7.goal: Plan the last dark shifts, 6 and 7
p02_shifts6_7.why: Sunrise is two shifts away. The battery must last.
p02_shifts6_7.result: Shifts 6 and 7 locked in. Sunrise is next.
p02_shifts6_7.hint: Use only what the battery can give until sunrise.

review_outcome.why: See what your plan did, or try again
review_outcome.result: Night finished. Sunrise is next. Go and see Alo.
review_outcome.hint: Try again takes you back before the night plan.

verify_chamber.goal: Check Alo's box is safe to open
verify_chamber.why: The air inside must be safe before you look
verify_chamber.hint: Check the air first. The window stays shut until then.

open_shutter.goal: Open the window on Alo's box
open_shutter.why: Alo flowered in the night. Come and see.
open_shutter.hint: The window opens only after the safety check.

tag_bloom.why: Saving it plays a message someone left for you
tag_bloom.result: Photo saved. An old message plays.

inspect_tara.goal: Look at Tara in the garden
inspect_tara.why: Alo needs a partner plant. Tara may be the one.
inspect_tara.result: Tara has a bud too. She was cared for all night.
inspect_tara.hint: See how much Tara has grown next to Alo.

complete_debrief.why: See your choices and what they changed
complete_debrief.hint: Look at your choices, then at what happened.

inspect_alo_identity.goal: Read Alo's label at the garden bay
inspect_alo_identity.why: Only matching flowers can make seeds together
inspect_alo_identity.result: Alo's label matches the plant record.
inspect_alo_identity.hint: Look at the label on the plant, not only the flower.

inspect_tara_identity.goal: Read Tara's label at the indoor plant bay
inspect_tara_identity.why: Tara needs her own checked record as Alo's partner
inspect_tara_identity.result: Tara's label is checked. Each partner has its own record.
inspect_tara_identity.hint: Find Tara's label beside the indoor plant.

ack_live_link.goal: Check Earth contact at the garden console
ack_live_link.why: Earth can only answer now if the link is open
ack_live_link.result: Earth contact is open. This talk is live.
ack_live_link.hint: Look at the contact light on the garden console.

open_pollination_protocol.goal: Read the pollen rules at the garden
open_pollination_protocol.why: Pollen must move while both chambers keep their air
open_pollination_protocol.result: Rules read. The chambers stay sealed, so you must be the bee.
open_pollination_protocol.hint: Look for three things: giving plant, receiving plant, sealed box.

identify_anther.goal: Find the anthers on the bench diagram
identify_anther.why: Pollen comes from the anthers of the giving flower
identify_anther.result: Anthers found. They hold the pollen.
identify_anther.hint: Anthers (the pollen tips) have a name label on the diagram.

identify_stigma.goal: Find the stigma on the bench diagram
identify_stigma.why: Pollen must touch the stigma to start a seed
identify_stigma.result: Stigma found. It catches the pollen.
identify_stigma.hint: The stigma (the sticky top) has a name label on the diagram.

assign_brush_directions.goal: Label both clean brushes at the bench
assign_brush_directions.why: One brush for each direction keeps the pollen unmixed
assign_brush_directions.result: Brushes labelled. One for each direction.
assign_brush_directions.hint: Read the plant names first, then label each brush.

practice_transfer_model.goal: Practise moving pollen at the practice bench
practice_transfer_model.why: Practising first keeps the real flowers safe
practice_transfer_model.result: Practice done on the model flower. Next, the real route.
practice_transfer_model.hint: Follow the name labels on the model before you touch a living flower.

check_space_weather.goal: Check space weather at the transfer station
check_space_weather.why: The Sun must be quiet before pollen goes through the airlock
check_space_weather.result: Space weather checked for this pollen trip.
check_space_weather.hint: Read the report and its date before you get the box ready.

prepare_closed_carrier.why: A closed box keeps the pollen safe inside
prepare_closed_carrier.result: The closed pollen box is ready.
prepare_closed_carrier.hint: Check its latch and its label before you move it.

verify_transfer_boundaries.why: If both doors open together, the chambers lose air
verify_transfer_boundaries.result: Door order checked. Both chambers keep their air.
verify_transfer_boundaries.hint: Follow the diagram there and back. Only one door opens each time.

preview_cycle_budget.goal: Try the whole pollen trip on the diagram
preview_cycle_budget.why: One route charge pays for there and back
preview_cycle_budget.result: Trip tried. One round trip costs one route charge. Nothing spent yet.
preview_cycle_budget.hint: Count both directions when you read the cost.

p03_scan_tara.goal: Scan Tara at the transfer microscope
p03_scan_tara.why: The pollen record must name the right giving plant
p03_scan_tara.result: Tara is scanned as the giving plant.
p03_scan_tara.hint: Read Tara's label before you take any pollen.

p03_collect_tara.goal: Take Tara's pollen at the transfer bench
p03_collect_tara.why: Alo's flower needs pollen from its partner
p03_collect_tara.result: Tara's pollen is on the labelled clean brush.
p03_collect_tara.hint: Brush the anthers (the pollen tips) you found in practice.

p03_seal_a.goal: Seal Tara's pollen box at the bench
p03_seal_a.why: A sealed box stops pollen escaping on the way
p03_seal_a.result: Tara's pollen box is sealed and labelled.
p03_seal_a.hint: Check the closed light before the box moves.

p03_transfer_alo.goal: Put Tara's pollen on Alo's flower
p03_transfer_alo.why: Pollen must touch Alo's stigma to start seeds
p03_transfer_alo.result: Tara's pollen is on Alo's flower. Seeds, if any, take weeks.
p03_transfer_alo.hint: Check both labels, then touch the stigma (the sticky top).

p03_scan_alo.goal: Scan Alo at the transfer microscope
p03_scan_alo.why: The trip back needs its own plant check
p03_scan_alo.result: Alo is scanned as the giving plant for the trip back.
p03_scan_alo.hint: Read Alo's label again. Do not reuse Tara's record.

p03_collect_alo.goal: Take Alo's pollen at the transfer bench
p03_collect_alo.why: The trip back needs the other clean brush
p03_collect_alo.result: Alo's pollen is on the other labelled clean brush.
p03_collect_alo.hint: Check this brush is the one for the trip back.

p03_seal_b.goal: Seal Alo's pollen box at the bench
p03_seal_b.why: The trip back needs the same sealed box check
p03_seal_b.result: Alo's pollen box is sealed and labelled.
p03_seal_b.hint: Check the closed light before the trip back starts.

p03_transfer_tara.goal: Put Alo's pollen on Tara's flower
p03_transfer_tara.why: Both plants need pollen from their partner
p03_transfer_tara.result: Alo's pollen is on Tara's flower. Both plants now have a partner.
p03_transfer_tara.hint: Check Tara's label, then touch the stigma.

record_stem_prediction.goal: Save your guess at the garden bench
record_stem_prediction.why: Stem colour shows some genes, not all. Save a guess to test
record_stem_prediction.result: Guess saved. Months from now you will compare it with what grows.
record_stem_prediction.hint: You can see the colour now. You cannot know the numbers yet.

order_lifecycle.goal: Put the growth pictures in order
order_lifecycle.why: Pollen today does not mean seeds tomorrow
order_lifecycle.result: Pictures are in order, from flower to harvest.
order_lifecycle.hint: Look at what each picture shows, then put them by date.

separate_current_evidence.goal: Sort the plant pictures at the Mission Table
separate_current_evidence.why: Old pictures must not be mixed with today's plants
separate_current_evidence.result: Sorted. Today's flowers, old seedlings and example pictures are apart.
separate_current_evidence.hint: Check where each picture came from and its date.

inspect_recorder_identifier.goal: Read the recorder label at the table
inspect_recorder_identifier.why: A matching number can join two old records
inspect_recorder_identifier.result: The recorder's number matches the old trial card. Take it to the service bench.
inspect_recorder_identifier.hint: Compare the whole number, not a person's initials.

collect_serial_card.goal: Photograph the serial number at the service bench
collect_serial_card.why: Peeling the new label would destroy the old one
collect_serial_card.result: Serial number photographed. The old label is not peeled.
collect_serial_card.hint: Use the camera. Keep the number and its label together.

collect_date_card.goal: Photograph the date at the service bench
collect_date_card.why: A date only counts if you know its source
collect_date_card.hint: Keep the date with the object it is written on.

collect_trial_stage_card.goal: Photograph the growth chart at the bench
collect_trial_stage_card.why: Seedlings are not flowers. The chart shows which
collect_trial_stage_card.result: Chart photographed. The old plants had not flowered.
collect_trial_stage_card.hint: Read what the chart says. Do not guess from curled leaves.

exclude_identity_claim.goal: Check the name clue at the service bench
exclude_identity_claim.why: A label on a machine cannot prove a person's name
exclude_identity_claim.result: No proof yet of who N. is, so the name stays a question.
exclude_identity_claim.hint: Ask which source really names a person.

assign_date_token.goal: Match the date on the evidence board
assign_date_token.why: The right date tells when the recording was made
assign_date_token.hint: Compare the empty date box with the date photograph.

assign_device_token.goal: Match the recorder on the evidence board
assign_device_token.why: The recording must come from the recorder you checked
assign_device_token.result: Recorder matched to its serial number.
assign_device_token.hint: Use the whole serial number, not a voice you remember.

assign_channel_token.goal: Match the channel on the evidence board
assign_channel_token.why: Work messages and personal memories are kept on separate channels
assign_channel_token.hint: Find the label that says what the recording is for.

verify_local_checksum.goal: Check the rebuilt copy at the service bench
verify_local_checksum.why: A whole copy keeps the evidence safe
verify_local_checksum.result: Rebuilt copy checked. Nothing lost. Now read what it says.
verify_local_checksum.hint: Check the copy first, then open the written words.

open_reconstructed_transcript.goal: Read the written words at the service bench
open_reconstructed_transcript.why: The rebuilt words need their date and source
open_reconstructed_transcript.result: Words ready. The recording itself can play next.
open_reconstructed_transcript.hint: Keep the date and source labels in view as you read.

play_engineer_fragment.goal: Play the old recording at the service bench
play_engineer_fragment.why: An old recorded order tells what happened on its date
play_engineer_fragment.result: An old recording from the first base. Its crew was ordered to leave.
play_engineer_fragment.hint: Read the date and label before you decide what the voice means.

play_n_memory.goal: Read N.'s memory at the service bench
play_n_memory.why: The gardener's words tell more, but not her name
play_n_memory.result: N.'s memory of mustard fields is read. Her full name is still unknown.
play_n_memory.hint: Keep the signature as written. Do not guess a name.

classify_voice_inference.goal: Sort the voice clue at the service bench
classify_voice_inference.why: Sounding alike is a question, not proof
classify_voice_inference.result: Saved as a guess. The voice sounds like Ferreira, but that is not proof.
classify_voice_inference.hint: Keep the recorded words apart from your guess about the speaker.

send_fragment_copy.goal: Send the evidence from the commons
send_fragment_copy.why: Ferreira needs the whole recording and its sources
send_fragment_copy.result: Copy sent to Ferreira with its sources. A reply may take time.
send_fragment_copy.hint: Send the copy with its labels. Do not add a guess.

acknowledge_handover.goal: Read the evening notes at the Mission Table
acknowledge_handover.why: The next watch needs the same checked facts
acknowledge_handover.result: Evening notes read. The personal question is still open.
acknowledge_handover.hint: Check what was sent and which questions still have no proof.

reach_interior_brace.goal: Go to the brace in the commons
reach_interior_brace.why: A moonquake shakes the ground. Hold a strong place inside
reach_interior_brace.result: You are at the marked brace inside.
reach_interior_brace.hint: Follow the marker inside. Do not leave the habitat.

account_four_cadets.goal: Check four cadets at the commons brace
account_four_cadets.why: After the quake, nobody must be missing
account_four_cadets.result: All four cadets answered at the brace.
account_four_cadets.hint: Read each cadet's answer, not only the place icons.

finish_quake_beat.goal: Save the quake check at the commons
finish_quake_beat.why: The next job needs this saved record
finish_quake_beat.result: Everyone is safe. But a red pressure warning is still on.
finish_quake_beat.hint: Keep the crew check and the warning together in the record.

p03_complete_run_1.goal: Finish the first pollen round trip
p03_complete_run_1.why: Both directions share one battery and air charge
p03_complete_run_1.result: First round trip done (1 of 3). Daily care comes next.
p03_complete_run_1.hint: Check both directions and both seals before you finish.

p03_complete_run_2.goal: Finish the second pollen round trip
p03_complete_run_2.why: Both directions share one battery and air charge
p03_complete_run_2.result: Second round trip done (2 of 3). More care days come next.
p03_complete_run_2.hint: Check both directions and both seals before you finish.

p03_complete_run_3.goal: Finish the third pollen round trip
p03_complete_run_3.why: Both directions share one battery and air charge
p03_complete_run_3.result: Third round trip done (3 of 3). Now guess what the seeds will grow.
p03_complete_run_3.hint: Check both directions and both seals before you finish.

p03_care_day_2.goal: Save care visit 2 at the transfer station
p03_care_day_2.why: Both plants need care every day between pollen trips
p03_care_day_2.result: Care visit 2 of seven saved with its date and notes.
p03_care_day_2.hint: Read the date and both plants' notes before you go on.

p03_care_day_3.goal: Save care visit 3 at the transfer station
p03_care_day_3.why: Both plants need care every day between pollen trips
p03_care_day_3.result: Care visit 3 of seven saved with its date and notes.
p03_care_day_3.hint: Read the date and both plants' notes before you go on.

p03_care_day_4.goal: Save care visit 4 at the transfer station
p03_care_day_4.why: Both plants need care every day between pollen trips
p03_care_day_4.result: Care visit 4 of seven saved with its date and notes.
p03_care_day_4.hint: Read the date and both plants' notes before you go on.

p03_care_day_5.goal: Save care visit 5 at the transfer station
p03_care_day_5.why: Both plants need care every day between pollen trips
p03_care_day_5.result: Care visit 5 of seven saved with its date and notes.
p03_care_day_5.hint: Read the date and both plants' notes before you go on.

p03_care_day_6.goal: Save care visit 6 at the transfer station
p03_care_day_6.why: Both plants need care every day between pollen trips
p03_care_day_6.result: Care visit 6 of seven saved with its date and notes.
p03_care_day_6.hint: Read the date and both plants' notes before you go on.

p03_care_day_7.goal: Save care visit 7 at the transfer station
p03_care_day_7.why: Both plants need care every day between pollen trips
p03_care_day_7.result: Care visit 7 of seven saved with its date and notes.
p03_care_day_7.hint: Read the date and both plants' notes before you go on.

p03_run_2_forward.goal: Bring Tara's pollen to Alo, second visit
p03_run_2_forward.why: Each pollen move needs its own dated record
p03_run_2_forward.result: Second visit. Tara's pollen to Alo is recorded.
p03_run_2_forward.hint: Check the giving and receiving plant labels first.

p03_run_2_reverse.goal: Bring Alo's pollen to Tara, second visit
p03_run_2_reverse.why: The trip back must be recorded too
p03_run_2_reverse.result: Second visit. Alo's pollen to Tara is recorded.
p03_run_2_reverse.hint: Check the trip-back brush and Tara's label first.

p03_run_3_forward.goal: Bring Tara's pollen to Alo, third visit
p03_run_3_forward.why: Each pollen move needs its own dated record
p03_run_3_forward.result: Third visit. Tara's pollen to Alo is recorded.
p03_run_3_forward.hint: Check the giving and receiving plant labels first.

p03_run_3_reverse.goal: Bring Alo's pollen to Tara, third visit
p03_run_3_reverse.why: The trip back must be recorded too
p03_run_3_reverse.result: Third visit. Alo's pollen to Tara is recorded.
p03_run_3_reverse.hint: Check the trip-back brush and Tara's label first.

p05_equip_gauge.goal: Check the gauge at the service stand
p05_equip_gauge.why: A screen can be wrong. A second gauge checks the warning
p05_equip_gauge.result: Gauge ready. You now have a second way to read pressure.
p05_equip_gauge.hint: Check the gauge's starting mark before you trust a reading.

p05_read_panel_warning.goal: Read the warning at the atmosphere console
p05_read_panel_warning.why: A red light alone cannot show where the leak is
p05_read_panel_warning.result: Warning read. The panel blames the tank. Now test that.
p05_read_panel_warning.hint: Keep what the screen says apart from what the gauge measures.

p05_identify_three_taps.goal: Find three taps on the service diagram
p05_identify_three_taps.why: You must know where each pressure reading comes from
p05_identify_three_taps.result: Main, garden and return taps found.
p05_identify_three_taps.hint: Follow each tap to the pipe it measures.

p05_identify_garden_fall.goal: Compare the pressure readings at the service console
p05_identify_garden_fall.why: The pipe whose pressure keeps falling has the leak
p05_identify_garden_fall.result: Found it. The garden pipe (the garden spur) is losing pressure.
p05_identify_garden_fall.hint: Compare each tap's first and second reading. Find the one that fell.

p05_verify_annex_isolation.goal: Check the annex is shut off
p05_verify_annex_isolation.why: The aftershock shut the annex pipe. Check it stayed shut
p05_verify_annex_isolation.result: Annex pipe is still shut after the aftershock.
p05_verify_annex_isolation.hint: Read the annex pipe light before you change another valve.

p05_preview_garden_isolation.goal: Try shutting off the garden pipe
p05_preview_garden_isolation.why: The habitat must still get its air
p05_preview_garden_isolation.result: Tried it. Closing only the garden pipe keeps the habitat's air. Nothing changed yet.
p05_preview_garden_isolation.hint: Compare what each shut-off would stop.

p05_rollback_check.goal: Read the undo check at the service console
p05_rollback_check.why: The crew must know when to stop and undo
p05_rollback_check.result: You know how to undo it if a reading goes wrong. Ready to repair.
p05_rollback_check.hint: Find the reading that would make the crew stop the repair.

p05_isolate_garden.why: You can only fix the leak when the pipe is shut
p05_isolate_garden.result: Garden pipe shut off for the repair.
p05_isolate_garden.hint: Match the valve label to the diagram before you close it.

p05_verify_main_hold.why: The habitat must keep its air during the repair
p05_verify_main_hold.result: Main pipe holds steady. The habitat's air is safe while you work.
p05_verify_main_hold.hint: Compare the main gauge with its earlier reading.

p05_apply_garden_clamp.goal: Fit the clamp from the safe side
p05_apply_garden_clamp.why: The clamp seals the leak so the air stays in
p05_apply_garden_clamp.result: Clamp fitted from the safe side, where there is air.
p05_apply_garden_clamp.hint: Check the pipe is shut off and marked, then fit the clamp.

p05_reopen_garden_slow.why: Opening slowly tests if the repair holds
p05_reopen_garden_slow.result: Garden pipe opened slowly for the test.
p05_reopen_garden_slow.hint: Watch the gauge as the pipe opens.

p05_reconcile_records.goal: Fix the repair notes at the service console
p05_reconcile_records.why: The next watch must know where the valves really are
p05_reconcile_records.result: Notes fixed. They match the real valve positions.
p05_reconcile_records.hint: Fix the wrong note. Do not undo the good repair.

p05_save_monitoring_handover.goal: Save the watch notes at the diagnostic board
p05_save_monitoring_handover.why: Looking by camera and going in need different checks
p05_save_monitoring_handover.result: Notes saved. The annex is next, by camera first.
p05_save_monitoring_handover.hint: Check the dates and who may go where before you save.

p05_isolate_annex_feed.goal: Shut off the annex lines at the port
p05_isolate_annex_feed.why: Shut off the annex's power and air lines before looking in
p05_isolate_annex_feed.result: Annex lines shut off for the camera look.
p05_isolate_annex_feed.hint: Use the safety drawing to find the right lines.

p05_confirm_zero_differential.goal: Check the pressure at the annex port
p05_confirm_zero_differential.why: Never open a port before you check its pressure
p05_confirm_zero_differential.result: Pressure is equal on both sides. Safe to use the viewing port.
p05_confirm_zero_differential.hint: Read the pressure gauge before you open the camera view.

p05_inspect_annex_hatch.goal: Look by camera at the annex port
p05_inspect_annex_hatch.why: Seeing by camera does not mean it is safe to enter
p05_inspect_annex_hatch.result: Camera shows the N.R. hatch. Suited entry is set for 8 May.
p05_inspect_annex_hatch.hint: Use the camera only. Going in waits for later checks.

p06_scan_growth_chart.goal: Scan the chart in the cold annex
p06_scan_growth_chart.why: Did the old garden ever flower? The chart will tell
p06_scan_growth_chart.result: Old growth chart scanned. It shows seedlings, before any flowers.
p06_scan_growth_chart.hint: Compare the chart's labels with what you see in the trays.

p06_scan_vault_map.goal: Scan the route sheet in the annex
p06_scan_vault_map.why: The old map shows where something was left
p06_scan_vault_map.result: Route sheet scanned. An old path leads away from the base.
p06_scan_vault_map.hint: Keep the map's date and source with the copy.

p06_exit_suit_check.goal: Check the way out of the annex
p06_exit_suit_check.why: Going in with a suit needs a safe way out
p06_exit_suit_check.result: Annex way out and suit checks are done.
p06_exit_suit_check.hint: Read the exit check back to the team on the warm side.

p06_accept_maturity_montage.goal: Look over the garden care days
p06_accept_maturity_montage.why: The plants keep growing while you study old records
p06_accept_maturity_montage.result: Care days looked over. Alo's seed pods are growing.
p06_accept_maturity_montage.hint: Follow the dated notes. Passing days alone do not prove ripe pods.

p06_save_map_provenance.goal: Save where the map came from
p06_save_map_provenance.why: An old route is a clue, not a safe road today
p06_save_map_provenance.result: Map saved with its source. The old crew left it before they evacuated.
p06_save_map_provenance.hint: Compare the map's date with the other archive dates.

p06_record_future_checks.goal: List the trip checks at the archive table
p06_record_future_checks.why: Today's slope, battery and radio still need checking
p06_record_future_checks.result: Listed. Slope, battery for the way home, and radio checks.
p06_record_future_checks.hint: Ask what an old map cannot tell you about today's rover trip.

p06_confirm_care_transition.goal: Check care to 16 May at the table
p06_confirm_care_transition.why: Pods need watching through May 16 to be ready
p06_confirm_care_transition.result: Care logged through 16 May. Alo's pods may be ready.
p06_confirm_care_transition.hint: Read the care dates and how the pods look now.

p06_confirm_maturity.goal: Check Alo's pods at the garden bench
p06_confirm_maturity.why: Drying starts only when the pods are ripe
p06_confirm_maturity.result: Alo's pods are ripe on May 16.
p06_confirm_maturity.hint: Compare the pod camera with the ripeness chart before changing the water.

p06_configure_drydown.goal: Set Alo's drying at the garden bench
p06_configure_drydown.why: Ripe pods must dry slowly before harvest
p06_configure_drydown.result: Watering stopped. Alo's pods dry for five days, 16 to 21 May.
p06_configure_drydown.hint: Check it is Alo and the pods are ripe before changing water.

p06_drydown_five_days.goal: Check the dried pods at the harvest bench
p06_drydown_five_days.why: Pods must be fully dry before opening, or seeds can spoil
p06_drydown_five_days.result: Five days of drying checked on May 21. The pods are dry.
p06_drydown_five_days.hint: Read the dryness reading and the date before you open the pods.

p06_open_six_pods.goal: Open Alo's pods over the harvest tray
p06_open_six_pods.why: Separate cups keep the seed count right
p06_open_six_pods.result: Six ripe pods opened into separate counting cups.
p06_open_six_pods.hint: Keep each pod's seeds in its own labelled cup.

p06_count_42.goal: Count the seeds at the harvest tray
p06_count_42.why: You must know the total before you share the seeds out
p06_count_42.result: Counted and checked again. Forty-two founder seeds.
p06_count_42.hint: Count each cup once, then compare with the harvest record.

p06_allocate_12_30.goal: Share out the seeds at the seed bench
p06_allocate_12_30.why: Some seeds to plant, some to keep safe. None lost
p06_allocate_12_30.result: Forty-two shared out. Twelve for planting and thirty kept safe.
p06_allocate_12_30.hint: Add both groups. They must make the total before you seal.

p06_sleeve_petal.goal: Save Alo's petal at the harvest bench
p06_sleeve_petal.why: Alo's life is over. Her petal belongs in the family record
p06_sleeve_petal.result: Alo's petal is saved in a sleeve. Her seeds carry her on.
p06_sleeve_petal.hint: Keep the saved petal apart from the tray for new plants.

p06_plant_12_positions.goal: Plant the twelve seeds at the garden rack
p06_plant_12_positions.why: Twelve seeds grow the next garden. Thirty stay sealed as backup
p06_plant_12_positions.result: Twelve seeds planted in labelled places.
p06_plant_12_positions.hint: Fill each labelled place. Do not take seeds from the thirty.

p06_seal_reserve_30.goal: Seal the founder seeds at the reserve store
p06_seal_reserve_30.why: Thirty founder seeds stay sealed and separate as backup
p06_seal_reserve_30.result: Thirty founder seeds sealed in the safe store.
p06_seal_reserve_30.hint: Check the box's seal and its count of thirty.

p06_preserve_lineage.goal: Label the family at the garden rack
p06_preserve_lineage.why: The new plants' record must name both parents
p06_preserve_lineage.result: Alo-by-Tara family label saved beside the planted tray.
p06_preserve_lineage.hint: Keep the parents' names on the label, beside any dedication.

p06_reconcile_continuity.goal: Look over the plant families at the board
p06_reconcile_continuity.why: Later gardens use working seeds. Founder seeds stay sealed
p06_reconcile_continuity.result: Months of care checked. Tara's nameplate is archived. Thirty founder seeds still sealed.
p06_reconcile_continuity.hint: Follow the care dates. Working seeds and founder seeds are different.

p06_confirm_descendant_survey.goal: Check the new plants at the garden rack
p06_confirm_descendant_survey.why: October's plants are later generations with their own dates
p06_confirm_descendant_survey.result: 21 October. The new plants are grown and a survey trip is planned.
p06_confirm_descendant_survey.hint: Read the newest labels. These are not May's seedlings.

p05_read_main_t0.goal: Take the first main reading at services
p05_read_main_t0.why: Read all three now and again later to see which falls
p05_read_main_t0.result: First main tank reading saved (1 of 6).
p05_read_main_t0.hint: Later, compare this tap with its own second reading.

p05_read_main_t10.goal: Take the second main reading at services
p05_read_main_t10.why: Readings at the same times show which pressure is falling
p05_read_main_t10.result: Second main tank reading saved (4 of 6).
p05_read_main_t10.hint: Compare this tap with its own first reading, not another tap.

p05_read_garden_t0.goal: Take the first garden reading at services
p05_read_garden_t0.why: Readings at the same times show which pressure is falling
p05_read_garden_t0.result: First garden pipe reading saved (2 of 6).
p05_read_garden_t0.hint: Later, compare this tap with its own second reading.

p05_read_garden_t10.goal: Take the second garden reading at services
p05_read_garden_t10.why: Readings at the same times show which pressure is falling
p05_read_garden_t10.result: Second garden pipe reading saved (5 of 6).
p05_read_garden_t10.hint: Compare this tap with its own first reading, not another tap.

p05_read_return_t0.goal: Take the first return reading at services
p05_read_return_t0.why: Readings at the same times show which pressure is falling
p05_read_return_t0.result: First return reading saved (3 of 6). Look at the parts while waiting.
p05_read_return_t0.hint: Later, compare this tap with its own second reading.

p05_read_return_t10.goal: Take the second return reading at services
p05_read_return_t10.why: Readings at the same times show which pressure is falling
p05_read_return_t10.result: Second return reading saved (6 of 6). Now compare the two sets.
p05_read_return_t10.hint: Compare this tap with its own first reading, not another tap.

p05_inspect_tank.goal: Look at the main tank at services
p05_inspect_tank.why: The main tank could be the leak. Only evidence can tell
p05_inspect_tank.result: Main tank looked at (part 1 of 6). A label is not proof.
p05_inspect_tank.hint: Compare this part with all three tap readings.

p05_inspect_habitat.goal: Look at the habitat pipe at services
p05_inspect_habitat.why: The habitat pipe could be the leak. Only evidence can tell
p05_inspect_habitat.result: Habitat pipe looked at (part 2 of 6). A label is not proof.
p05_inspect_habitat.hint: Compare this part with all three tap readings.

p05_inspect_garden.goal: Look at the garden pipe joint at services
p05_inspect_garden.why: The garden pipe joint could be the leak. Only evidence can tell
p05_inspect_garden.result: Garden pipe joint looked at (part 3 of 6). A label is not proof.
p05_inspect_garden.hint: Compare this part with all three tap readings.

p05_inspect_return.goal: Look at the return pipe at services
p05_inspect_return.why: The return pipe could be the leak. Only evidence can tell
p05_inspect_return.result: Return pipe looked at (part 4 of 6). A label is not proof.
p05_inspect_return.hint: Compare this part with all three tap readings.

p05_inspect_airlock.goal: Look at the airlock seal at services
p05_inspect_airlock.why: The airlock seal could be the leak. Only evidence can tell
p05_inspect_airlock.result: Airlock seal looked at (part 5 of 6). A label is not proof.
p05_inspect_airlock.hint: Compare this part with all three tap readings.

p05_inspect_annex.goal: Look at the annex pipe at services
p05_inspect_annex.why: The annex pipe could be the leak. Only evidence can tell
p05_inspect_annex.result: Annex pipe looked at (part 6 of 6). Time for the second readings.
p05_inspect_annex.hint: Compare this part with all three tap readings.

p05_stable_read_1.goal: Save steady check 1 at the service console
p05_stable_read_1.why: Many readings prove the repair still holds
p05_stable_read_1.result: Steady check 1 of five saved for main, garden and return.
p05_stable_read_1.hint: Read all three gauges now. Do not reuse an old reading.

p05_stable_read_2.goal: Save steady check 2 at the service console
p05_stable_read_2.why: Many readings prove the repair still holds
p05_stable_read_2.result: Steady check 2 of five saved for main, garden and return.
p05_stable_read_2.hint: Read all three gauges now. Do not reuse an old reading.

p05_stable_read_3.goal: Save steady check 3 at the service console
p05_stable_read_3.why: Many readings prove the repair still holds
p05_stable_read_3.result: Steady check 3 of five saved for main, garden and return.
p05_stable_read_3.hint: Read all three gauges now. Do not reuse an old reading.

p05_stable_read_4.goal: Save steady check 4 at the service console
p05_stable_read_4.why: Many readings prove the repair still holds
p05_stable_read_4.result: Steady check 4 of five saved for main, garden and return.
p05_stable_read_4.hint: Read all three gauges now. Do not reuse an old reading.

p05_stable_read_5.goal: Save steady check 5 at the service console
p05_stable_read_5.why: Many readings prove the repair still holds
p05_stable_read_5.result: Steady check 5 of five. The repair holds.
p05_stable_read_5.hint: Read all three gauges now. Do not reuse an old reading.

p07_compare_prediction.goal: Compare your guess at the garden rack
p07_compare_prediction.why: A fair test keeps the first guess in view
p07_compare_prediction.result: Your first stem-colour guess is compared with today's plants.
p07_compare_prediction.hint: Read what you guessed before you look at the new plants.

p07_inspect_twelve_descendants.goal: Look at twelve new plants at the rack
p07_inspect_twelve_descendants.why: Count these plants yourself. Old numbers do not count
p07_inspect_twelve_descendants.result: Twelve new plants seen. Seven purple stems and five green.
p07_inspect_twelve_descendants.hint: Use the written readings as well as the stem colours.

p07_record_trait_limits.goal: Save what is still unsure at the rack
p07_record_trait_limits.why: Twelve plants are too few to show every gene
p07_record_trait_limits.result: Report saved. Twelve plants is a small sample, so no fixed ratio.
p07_record_trait_limits.hint: A count of twelve is not a rule for all plants.

p07_check_rover_seal.goal: Check the cabin seals at the rover bay
p07_check_rover_seal.why: If a seal leaks, the rover crew loses air
p07_check_rover_seal.hint: Compare the closed light with the pressure light.

p07_check_scanner.goal: Check the scanner at the rover bay
p07_check_scanner.why: An untested scanner cannot prove there is ice
p07_check_scanner.result: Scanner tested and ready before leaving.
p07_check_scanner.hint: Find the scanner test in the packing list.

p07_check_closed_carrier.goal: Check the sample box at the rover bay
p07_check_closed_carrier.why: The ice sample must travel home in a sealed box
p07_check_closed_carrier.result: Closed sample box checked and packed.
p07_check_closed_carrier.hint: Read the latch light and the sample label before leaving.

p07_complete_base_handover.goal: Share the plan at the rover bay
p07_complete_base_handover.why: The two cadets at home must know the trip plan
p07_complete_base_handover.result: Plan shared. Rafi and Kai drive, Mei and Amara guide from base.
p07_complete_base_handover.hint: Read the home notes beside the rover packing list.

p07_choose_route_b.goal: Choose a route at the rover console
p07_choose_route_b.why: The slope and the battery for the way home must be safe
p07_choose_route_b.result: Route chosen. Not too steep, with enough battery to come back.
p07_choose_route_b.hint: Compare each route's steepest slope and its full cost there and back.

p07_verify_slope.goal: Check the slope at the rover console
p07_verify_slope.why: A short road can be too steep for the rover
p07_verify_slope.result: The route's steepest part is within the rover's limit.
p07_verify_slope.hint: Use the steepest part, not the average slope.

p07_verify_return_reserve.goal: Check the battery for the way home
p07_verify_return_reserve.why: Getting there is only half the trip
p07_verify_return_reserve.result: The round trip leaves the battery reserve that the rules ask for.
p07_verify_return_reserve.hint: Add the way home before you look at what is left.

p07_prepare_departure.goal: Check you are ready to leave
p07_prepare_departure.why: The packing and the shared plan must match
p07_prepare_departure.result: Ready to go. The rover heads for the cold-trap ridge.
p07_prepare_departure.hint: Compare the chosen route with the packing list and the shared plan.

p07_record_dry_reference.goal: Measure dry ground at the survey station
p07_record_dry_reference.why: You must know dry ground before you can spot ice
p07_record_dry_reference.result: Dry ground measured. This is what no ice looks like.
p07_record_dry_reference.hint: Read the dry number before you set the ice limit.

p07_set_threshold_12.goal: Set the ice limit at the survey station
p07_set_threshold_12.why: Every sample must be judged by the same limit
p07_set_threshold_12.result: Limit set. Readings above it count as ice.
p07_set_threshold_12.hint: Set the limit above the dry ground number, by the amount shown.

p07_tag_positive_18.goal: Test the first sample at the survey station
p07_tag_positive_18.why: A bright picture is not enough. The scanner must agree
p07_tag_positive_18.result: Sample 1 is above the limit. The scanner says ice.
p07_tag_positive_18.hint: Compare this sample's number with the limit.

p07_tag_positive_19.goal: Test the second sample at the survey station
p07_tag_positive_19.why: Each sample needs its own measurement
p07_tag_positive_19.result: Sample 2 is also above the limit. A second ice reading.
p07_tag_positive_19.hint: Use the same limit for this new sample.

p07_retain_negative_2.goal: Keep the low sample at the sample points
p07_retain_negative_2.why: An honest report also keeps the no-ice results
p07_retain_negative_2.result: Low sample kept. It proves the scanner can say no.
p07_retain_negative_2.hint: Keep the below-limit reading even if its picture looks exciting.

p07_seal_sample.goal: Seal the ice sample at the sample point
p07_seal_sample.why: Seal it with its place written down, so people can trust it
p07_seal_sample.result: Sample sealed. Check the way home before touching that case.
p07_seal_sample.hint: Keep the ice sample record apart from the vault case.

p07_commit_return_route.goal: Check the trip home at the rover mount
p07_commit_return_route.why: A new find must not stop you getting home
p07_commit_return_route.result: Enough battery to carry the case home. You can pick it up.
p07_commit_return_route.hint: Read the battery left now, before you add the new job.

p08_read_external_probe.goal: Read the probe at the vault case
p08_read_external_probe.why: The outside temperature cannot tell what the seeds inside went through
p08_read_external_probe.result: The outside of the case is safe to handle.
p08_read_external_probe.hint: Compare the probe with the safe range. Keep the inner seal shut.

p08_fit_sleeve.goal: Fit the sleeve at the vault case
p08_fit_sleeve.why: The cold case must travel wrapped and sealed
p08_fit_sleeve.result: Sleeve fitted around the closed vault case.
p08_fit_sleeve.hint: Check the sleeve sits right before you lift.

p08_latch_cradle.goal: Latch the cradle at the vault case
p08_latch_cradle.why: The case must be held firmly before it moves
p08_latch_cradle.result: Cradle latched. The inner seal is unbroken.
p08_latch_cradle.hint: Read the position light and latch light before moving the case.

p08_secure_mount.goal: Lock the case on the rover mount
p08_secure_mount.why: A closed latch can still be loose. Test the lock
p08_secure_mount.result: Vault case locked to the rover cargo mount.
p08_secure_mount.hint: Test the lock. Do not trust how it looks.

p08_return_to_base.goal: Bring the closed case back to Aurora
p08_return_to_base.why: The old seeds need careful handling at home
p08_return_to_base.result: Back at Aurora with the sealed cargo and crew.
p08_return_to_base.hint: Keep both cargo records and the battery reserve in the notes.

p08_dock_dry_glovebox.goal: Put the case in the dry cargo lock
p08_dock_dry_glovebox.why: Slow, dry warming protects the unopened seeds
p08_dock_dry_glovebox.result: Closed vault case is in the dry cargo lock, still sealed.
p08_dock_dry_glovebox.hint: Check the space is dry before the warming starts.

p08_warm_cold.goal: Start the sealed warming at the dry glovebox
p08_warm_cold.why: Warming slowly stops water drops forming on the cold case
p08_warm_cold.result: Warm-up 1 of 3 recorded. Still sealed, warming slowly.
p08_warm_cold.hint: Follow the warming chart. Leave the inner seal closed.

p08_warm_cool.goal: Check warm-up 2 at the dry glovebox
p08_warm_cool.why: The middle step needs its own check
p08_warm_cool.hint: Compare the temperature now with the next allowed step.

p08_warm_room.goal: Finish the sealed warming at the dry glovebox
p08_warm_room.why: The case must reach room temperature before it opens
p08_warm_room.result: Warm-up 3 of 3 checked. The case is at room temperature.
p08_warm_room.hint: Read the steady-temperature check before you ask to open the seal.

p08_check_condensation.goal: Check for water drops at the glovebox
p08_check_condensation.why: Water drops would harm the old seeds
p08_check_condensation.result: Dry. No water drops. Safe to open.
p08_check_condensation.hint: Read the dryness lights after the warming is done.

p08_open_inner_seal.goal: Open the seal inside the dry glovebox
p08_open_inner_seal.why: Inside the dry glovebox the seeds are safe to look at
p08_open_inner_seal.result: Vault inner seal opened inside the dry glovebox.
p08_open_inner_seal.hint: Check the warming and dryness records before you open the seal.

p08_inventory_12.goal: Count the vault seeds at the dry glovebox
p08_inventory_12.why: Each different seed needs a note on how it looks
p08_inventory_12.result: Twelve different vault seeds counted. None planted here.
p08_inventory_12.hint: Match each cup with the packing list. Do not count album pictures.

p08_scan_lid.goal: Scan the lid writing at the dry glovebox
p08_scan_lid.why: Copy every word exactly. Do not guess who wrote it
p08_scan_lid.result: Lid writing scanned and saved exactly.
p08_scan_lid.hint: Keep the picture beside the copied words.

p08_save_viability_pending.goal: Save the seeds as not tested yet
p08_save_viability_pending.why: Bringing seeds home does not prove they can still grow
p08_save_viability_pending.result: Saved. Nobody knows yet if these seeds can still grow.
p08_save_viability_pending.hint: Safe at home is one thing. Able to grow is another.

p08_transfer_case.goal: Pass the case through the dry cargo lock
p08_transfer_case.why: The seeds need one known home where they are looked after
p08_transfer_case.result: Case passed inside, still sealed, for the garden glovebox.
p08_transfer_case.hint: Keep the closed case and its condition notes together.

p08_manifest_reconciled.goal: Check the cargo record at the supply record
p08_manifest_reconciled.why: What came home must match what left the vault
p08_manifest_reconciled.result: Cargo record matches. One sealed vault case, and both crew within their reserve.
p08_manifest_reconciled.hint: Check each different label once. Do not add extra seeds.

p08_personnel_home.goal: Mark everyone home at the handover console
p08_personnel_home.why: Both rover cadets must be home before the trip ends
p08_personnel_home.result: Both rover cadets are home with the base team.
p08_personnel_home.hint: Read the names and their answers, not only the cargo report.

p08_quarantine_complete.why: The sealed case must stay protected on its way to the garden
p08_quarantine_complete.result: Safe waiting done. The sealed case goes to the garden glovebox next.
p08_quarantine_complete.hint: Check the condition notes before you close the record.

p08_send_manifest.goal: Send the packing list from the Earth console
p08_send_manifest.why: Ferreira needs to see exactly what you found
p08_send_manifest.result: Packing list and lid photo sent to Earth.
p08_send_manifest.hint: Send the record with its sources. Do not add a guess.

p08_record_ferreira_question.goal: Save the question beside the lid writing
p08_record_ferreira_question.why: The lid writing lets you ask, not blame
p08_record_ferreira_question.result: Question for Ferreira saved beside the exact lid writing.
p08_record_ferreira_question.hint: Ask what the lid really shows and what still needs an answer.

p08_leave_identity_open.goal: Check what the lid really proves
p08_leave_identity_open.why: Initials alone cannot tell the gardener's full name
p08_leave_identity_open.result: Who the gardener was is still unknown. Only Ferreira can say more.
p08_leave_identity_open.hint: Keep the initials as written until a signed page says more.

p08_check_relief_flight.goal: Read Ferreira's flight notice at the Earth screen
p08_check_relief_flight.why: Ferreira is coming. A fifth person needs air, food and space
p08_check_relief_flight.result: Ferreira flies 8 to 12 December. She will bring her story.
p08_check_relief_flight.hint: Read the leaving and landing dates, then get her place ready.

p08_prepare_locker.goal: Get Ferreira's locker ready in the commons
p08_prepare_locker.why: The new commander needs her own place and supplies
p08_prepare_locker.result: Ferreira's locker is ready and matches the arrival packing list.
p08_prepare_locker.hint: Check the traveller's name and what she needs.

p08_confirm_december_transition.goal: Look over the days until Ferreira arrives
p08_confirm_december_transition.why: The base needs care through the weeks of waiting
p08_confirm_december_transition.result: Weeks of care logged. It is 12 December. Ferreira lands today.
p08_confirm_december_transition.hint: Read the dated care and supply notes before you go on.

p07_place_beacon_1.goal: Put beacon 1 on the beacon mast
p07_place_beacon_1.why: Past the blind corner, beacons carry the radio home
p07_place_beacon_1.result: Beacon 1 of 3 placed. Its link reaches home.
p07_place_beacon_1.hint: Check the beacon sits firmly and its link works before moving on.

p07_place_beacon_2.goal: Put beacon 2 on the beacon mast
p07_place_beacon_2.why: Each beacon must hear the one before it
p07_place_beacon_2.result: Beacon 2 of 3 placed. The radio chain grows.
p07_place_beacon_2.hint: Check the beacon sits firmly and its link works before moving on.

p07_place_beacon_3.goal: Put beacon 3 on the beacon mast
p07_place_beacon_3.why: The last beacon finishes the chain around the corner
p07_place_beacon_3.result: Beacon 3 of 3 placed. An unbroken radio chain home.
p07_place_beacon_3.hint: Check the beacon sits firmly and its link works before moving on.

p09_check_lander_clearance.goal: Check the landing-pad camera in the rover bay
p09_check_lander_clearance.why: The welcome must wait until the landing pad is clear
p09_check_lander_clearance.result: Lander area is clear. Checked before anyone crosses.
p09_check_lander_clearance.hint: Read both clear checks before you open the way across.

p09_check_seals.goal: Check the dock seals in the rover bay
p09_check_seals.why: If a seal leaks, air escapes when people cross
p09_check_seals.hint: Compare the closed light and pressure light before the inner door opens.

p09_verify_five_person_roster.goal: Add Ferreira at the departure boards
p09_verify_five_person_roster.why: Aurora now keeps five people alive on the Moon
p09_verify_five_person_roster.result: Crew list of five checked, with Ferreira on it.
p09_verify_five_person_roster.hint: Match each name to who is here now.

p09_store_spare_once.goal: Put the spare part in the sealed crate
p09_store_spare_once.why: Ferreira brought a spare radio part. Keep it easy to find
p09_store_spare_once.result: Spare relay controller stored with its repair diagram.
p09_store_spare_once.hint: Check its serial number and locker record. Store it only once.

p09_run_arrival_readings.goal: Take arrival readings at the air console
p09_run_arrival_readings.why: Five people now breathe here. Check the air numbers
p09_run_arrival_readings.result: Arrival readings saved for the five-person base.
p09_run_arrival_readings.hint: Read the gauges now. Do not copy the old watch.

p09_reconcile_readings.goal: Match the readings at the second gauge
p09_reconcile_readings.why: Copied notes must match what the real gauges show
p09_reconcile_readings.result: Arrival readings now match the second gauge.
p09_reconcile_readings.hint: If an old note is different, keep the checked fix in view.

p09_commit_sequence.goal: Put the four 2034 records in order
p09_commit_sequence.why: Their times show what really happened when the old crew left
p09_commit_sequence.result: Order found. Every old crew member boarded and went home safely.
p09_commit_sequence.hint: Compare the times and every boarding signature before you decide.

p10_document_young_trial.goal: Write about the old trial at the table
p10_document_young_trial.why: The old photos show young seedlings, not flowers
p10_document_young_trial.result: Old trial written down as young seedlings with no flowers.
p10_document_young_trial.hint: Match the growth sheet with the leaves you see. Do not guess flowers.

p10_exclude_flower_claim.goal: Check the flower claim at the archive images
p10_exclude_flower_claim.why: Saying it flowered without proof would spoil the evidence
p10_exclude_flower_claim.result: Claim removed. The old garden never flowered. Alo did.
p10_exclude_flower_claim.hint: Ask which dated record really shows a flower.

p10_save_source_scope.goal: Save the report at the archive images
p10_save_source_scope.why: A photograph cannot show the moments nobody saw
p10_save_source_scope.result: Old-trial report saved. It says what the sources can and cannot show.
p10_save_source_scope.hint: Write only what the old records really show.

p10_acknowledge_ferreira_facts.goal: Read Ferreira's facts at the Mission Table
p10_acknowledge_ferreira_facts.why: Hear what happened, without deciding who to blame
p10_acknowledge_ferreira_facts.result: Ferreira's facts are read, and why the old crew pulled back.
p10_acknowledge_ferreira_facts.hint: Compare her words with the order to leave and the boarding records.

p10_acknowledge_personal_question.goal: Read both sides at the Mission Table
p10_acknowledge_personal_question.why: A crew can work together and still disagree
p10_acknowledge_personal_question.result: Both sides heard. Nobody has to decide right now.
p10_acknowledge_personal_question.hint: Read the other side before you close the talk.

p10_preserve_safety_facts.goal: Check safety records at the Mission Table
p10_preserve_safety_facts.why: Safety help must stay ready, even with questions unanswered
p10_preserve_safety_facts.result: Safety facts are kept here and ready for the crew.
p10_preserve_safety_facts.hint: Keep the safety steps apart from the personal questions.

p10_compare_dust_repair.goal: Compare the panel-cleaning record at the records desk
p10_compare_dust_repair.why: The solar panels make less power. Dust may be why
p10_compare_dust_repair.result: Dust explains the lost solar power. One repair understood.
p10_compare_dust_repair.hint: Ask which number should change after the panel is cleaned.

p10_compare_leak_repair.goal: Compare the leak record at the records desk
p10_compare_leak_repair.why: Losing pressure is a different problem with its own repair
p10_compare_leak_repair.result: Leak record compared. The garden pipe needs a patch.
p10_compare_leak_repair.hint: Look at the pressure readings. Panel power tells nothing about a leak.

p10_keep_spare_present.why: Knowing the spare fits is getting ready, not a repair
p10_keep_spare_present.result: Spare stays packed. Today's radio still works.
p10_keep_spare_present.hint: Check the spare and its steps. Do not use it up.

p10_verify_flashes.goal: Check the flashes at the impact-camera monitor
p10_verify_flashes.why: Real impacts flash once. A camera fault stays in one spot
p10_verify_flashes.result: Six real impact flashes found. Two camera faults ruled out.
p10_verify_flashes.hint: Compare the pictures before and after. See if the spot stays.

p10_clean_panel.goal: Clean the panel from the maintenance console
p10_clean_panel.why: Dust blocks sunlight, so the panel makes less power
p10_clean_panel.result: Dusty panel cleaned and its power checked.
p10_clean_panel.hint: Compare the panel's power before and after cleaning.

p10_patch_dome_spur.goal: Patch the garden pipe at its valve
p10_patch_dome_spur.why: The shut-off leak still costs air until it is patched
p10_patch_dome_spur.result: Damaged garden pipe patched from the safe side.
p10_patch_dome_spur.hint: Check the pipe is shut off. Keep the garden chamber sealed.

p10_verify_pressure.goal: Check the garden pipe's pressure chart
p10_verify_pressure.why: A patch only counts if the pressure holds
p10_verify_pressure.hint: Read the pressure chart. Do not judge by the patch picture.

p10_exclude_unsupported_impact_claim.goal: Check the old-fault claim at the table
p10_exclude_unsupported_impact_claim.why: Tonight's flashes do not prove an old impact
p10_exclude_unsupported_impact_claim.result: Tonight's flashes cannot explain the old fault, so that stays unknown.
p10_exclude_unsupported_impact_claim.hint: Compare the dates. Does the old report prove a strike?

p10_save_report.goal: Save the report at the Earth screen
p10_save_report.why: A good report shows the evidence and what it cannot show
p10_save_report.result: Report saved, saying only what the evidence shows.
p10_save_report.hint: Keep the flash pictures, repair charts and archive dates apart.

p10_match_noor_identity.goal: Match the signed page at the Mission Table
p10_match_noor_identity.why: A page she agreed to share can finally name the gardener
p10_match_noor_identity.result: The signed page shows N.R. is Dr. Noor Rahman.
p10_match_noor_identity.hint: Compare the signed page with the vault packing list.

p10_record_consent.goal: Read the permission note at the Mission Table
p10_record_consent.why: A personal story may only be shared if she agrees
p10_record_consent.result: Noor's permission is recorded, and how the reports reached Earth.
p10_record_consent.hint: Read what she let you share and how the reports reached Earth.

p10_confirm_founder_role.goal: Check Noor's history at the Earth screen
p10_confirm_founder_role.why: The link to the Academy needs the same kind of proof
p10_confirm_founder_role.result: Noor survived, and she founded the Last Light Academy.
p10_confirm_founder_role.hint: Use the page she agreed to share. Do not guess from initials.

p10_send_invitation.goal: Send Noor an invitation from the message composer
p10_send_invitation.why: She can choose whether to answer, and when
p10_send_invitation.result: Invitation sent. Now it is Noor's choice to answer.
p10_send_invitation.hint: Pick the invitation that lets her choose.

p10_plant_cotton.goal: Plant cotton in Tara's indoor plant bay
p10_plant_cotton.why: One cleared vault seed can keep the living test going
p10_plant_cotton.result: Cotton planted on December 15 in the indoor plant bay, which holds air.
p10_plant_cotton.hint: Check the safe waiting record and the plant box before planting.

p10_protect_eleven_vault.goal: Check vault storage at the garden console
p10_protect_eleven_vault.why: After the cotton, eleven other vault seeds stay protected
p10_protect_eleven_vault.result: Eleven unplanted vault seeds are kept in safe storage.
p10_protect_eleven_vault.hint: Use the vault list. The founder seed record is a different one.

p10_protect_founder_reserve.why: The thirty original seeds stay as a separate backup
p10_protect_founder_reserve.result: Founder seeds checked. Thirty original seeds still sealed.
p10_protect_founder_reserve.hint: Read the founder box's own seal record. Do not use working seeds.

p11_charge_hand_light.goal: Charge the lamp at the power-room locker
p11_charge_hand_light.why: An eclipse is coming. Kai wants his old light charged
p11_charge_hand_light.result: The old hand light is charged and checked.
p11_charge_hand_light.hint: Read its charge light. You do not need a brighter lamp.

p11_assign_companion.why: A friend can help without leaving their own job
p11_assign_companion.result: Kai will not face the dark alone. Everyone keeps their own job.
p11_assign_companion.hint: Check who can stay with Kai and still do their own job.

p11_check_locker.goal: Check the lamp locker in the power room
p11_check_locker.why: The crew must know where the light is kept
p11_check_locker.result: Lamp locker checked. The crew can reach it.
p11_check_locker.hint: Keep the light in the planned place, easy to reach.

p11_read_personal_log.goal: Read Kai's memory at the power-room desk
p11_read_personal_log.why: Knowing his fear helps the crew plan how to help
p11_read_personal_log.result: Kai's log read. The dark still scares him, and he says so.
p11_read_personal_log.hint: Use the log to see what would make the plan clearer.

p11_identify_protected_path.goal: Follow the guide-light line in the power room
p11_identify_protected_path.why: The most needed things must keep power in the dark
p11_identify_protected_path.result: Found the protected line that keeps the guide light on.
p11_identify_protected_path.hint: Follow the needed things past the shut-off point.

p11_identify_fault_method.goal: Find how to report a fault
p11_identify_fault_method.why: If something trips, the crew must be able to call each other
p11_identify_fault_method.result: Found the way to report a fault from here.
p11_identify_fault_method.hint: Check how to call the crew without using the camera line.

p11_commit_allocation.goal: Lock in the eclipse power plan
p11_commit_allocation.why: Seven power units must keep the needed things on through five phases
p11_commit_allocation.result: Eclipse power plan locked in. Needed things stay on in all five phases.
p11_commit_allocation.hint: Count the needed things and one-time jobs against the power you have.

p11_remove_decorative_floods.why: Extra brightness eats the power saved for after the eclipse
p11_remove_decorative_floods.result: Decorative floodlights taken out of the eclipse plan.
p11_remove_decorative_floods.hint: Decorative means only for looks. Keep the lights that keep you safe.

p11_protect_guide_light.goal: Keep the guide light at the power board
p11_protect_guide_light.why: One small light on a safe line guides the crew
p11_protect_guide_light.result: Guide light stays on, on the protected line.
p11_protect_guide_light.hint: Its line is not the same as the floodlights' line. Follow it.

p11_protect_reserve.goal: Check the leftover power at the power board
p11_protect_reserve.why: Some power must be left to restart after the eclipse
p11_protect_reserve.result: Reserve checked. Power is left over to restart after the eclipse.
p11_protect_reserve.hint: Compare all the planned power use with the reserve shown.

p12_test_branch.goal: Test the practice line at the test panel
p12_test_branch.why: A practice run shows safely what gets shut off
p12_test_branch.result: Practice line tested, then put back.
p12_test_branch.hint: Guess which light should change, then run the safe test.

p12_verify_protected_services.goal: Check the needed things at the test panel
p12_verify_protected_services.why: One broken line must not stop air, heat or the garden
p12_verify_protected_services.result: Air, heat and garden lines stay steady.
p12_verify_protected_services.hint: Watch the protected lights while the test line is off.

p12_record_rehearsal.goal: Save the practice at the test panel
p12_record_rehearsal.why: Practice records must not be mixed with real events
p12_record_rehearsal.result: Practice saved. You know what to do if a fault happens.
p12_record_rehearsal.hint: Label it as practice, not a real eclipse fault.

p12_check_four_roles.goal: Share crew checks at the Mission Table
p12_check_four_roles.why: Ready only counts when every cadet has checked their part
p12_check_four_roles.result: All four cadets' ready reports are shared and checked.
p12_check_four_roles.hint: Read each cadet's note, then mark the matching check.

p12_check_five_segments.goal: Look over five phases at the Mission Table
p12_check_five_segments.why: Getting ready and restarting are part of the plan too
p12_check_five_segments.result: All five eclipse phases match the plan.
p12_check_five_segments.hint: Read the getting-ready and restart cards too, not only the ring view.

p12_ready_camera.why: The camera needs its filter to watch the Sun safely
p12_ready_camera.result: Filtered camera is ready on its checked line.
p12_ready_camera.hint: Read the camera's filter light and power light.

p12_log_ingress.goal: Save the eclipse start at the camera monitor
p12_log_ingress.why: Earth begins to cover the Sun. Note the time
p12_log_ingress.result: Eclipse start saved. Earth is moving across the Sun.
p12_log_ingress.hint: Keep the picture's camera label and time label with it.

p12_log_ring.goal: Save the ring at the camera monitor
p12_log_ring.why: The red ring has a reason. Learn what makes it
p12_log_ring.result: Red ring saved. Sunlight bends through Earth's air, every sunrise and sunset at once.
p12_log_ring.hint: Use the filtered view. The diagram is a drawing, not a measurement.

p12_deliver_family_contact.goal: Connect the family call at the Earth screen
p12_deliver_family_contact.why: A call only works if the Earth link is open
p12_deliver_family_contact.result: Family message sent through the Earth link.
p12_deliver_family_contact.hint: Read the contact light. The eclipse does not open the radio.

p12_preserve_observation_qualifications.goal: Check the eclipse notes at the message log
p12_preserve_observation_qualifications.why: A drawing from the story is not a real measurement
p12_preserve_observation_qualifications.result: Eclipse notes kept honest. Camera pictures and diagrams are labelled apart.
p12_preserve_observation_qualifications.hint: Keep checked calendar facts apart from drawings nobody measured.

p12_store_known_noor_text.goal: Save Noor's text at the message log
p12_store_known_noor_text.why: You know who signs N. now. Just save her words
p12_store_known_noor_text.result: Noor's text saved, with when and how it came.
p12_store_known_noor_text.hint: Read it as words from the writer you already know.

p12_reserve_live_voice.goal: Check the message type at the message log
p12_reserve_live_voice.why: A text message is not the same as a live voice
p12_reserve_live_voice.result: It is a text message. Noor's voice is still to come.
p12_reserve_live_voice.hint: Compare the message type with what the channel shows now.

p12_reset_sequence.goal: Fix the camera line at the service board
p12_reset_sequence.why: The camera picture failed. Shut off its line, then reset it
p12_reset_sequence.result: Camera line safely back on. The habitat's needed things stayed on.
p12_reset_sequence.hint: Follow the checked steps and check the safety locks before reset.

p12_record_egress.goal: Save the eclipse end at the camera monitor
p12_record_egress.why: Sunlight returns. Save the end to finish your watching
p12_record_egress.result: Eclipse end saved. Sunlight is back.
p12_record_egress.hint: Compare the view now with the saved start and ring.

p12_reconcile_recovery_reserve.goal: Check final power at the eclipse power board
p12_reconcile_recovery_reserve.why: All the power must add up in one plan
p12_reconcile_recovery_reserve.result: Power checked. The plan held, with reserve to spare.
p12_reconcile_recovery_reserve.hint: Use the same power plan. Do not charge extra for the fault.

p12_save_recovery.goal: Save the restart at the service board
p12_save_recovery.why: An honest report keeps the camera break in it
p12_save_recovery.result: The break, the fix and the last view are saved together.
p12_save_recovery.hint: Keep the camera fault in the report. Do not erase it.

p12_reconcile_monitoring.goal: Share the watch plan at the monitoring calendar
p12_reconcile_monitoring.why: Rafi spotted an active region on the Sun. Keep watching it
p12_reconcile_monitoring.result: Watch plan saved. Everyone knows who checks the Sun, and when.
p12_reconcile_monitoring.hint: Write who checks the next Sun report.

p12_date_february_warning.goal: Put the date on the new warning
p12_date_february_warning.why: January's watching cannot tell the exact day of a February storm
p12_date_february_warning.result: The storm warning is dated 14 February. The storm is coming.
p12_date_february_warning.hint: Compare the new warning's date with the earlier watch note.

p12_confirm_care_ledger.goal: Check care records at the garden console
p12_confirm_care_ledger.why: The garden and the stored seeds still need looking after
p12_confirm_care_ledger.result: Dated care records checked for the whole watching time.
p12_confirm_care_ledger.hint: Tell apart living plants, archived first plants and the stored seeds.

p13_share_observations.goal: Share the warning at the Mission Table
p13_share_observations.why: Everyone must see the same storm warning before planning
p13_share_observations.result: The storm readings are shared with the whole crew.
p13_share_observations.hint: Read where each fact comes from before you plan.

p13_label_counterfactual.goal: Label the storm replay as a what-if
p13_label_counterfactual.why: This real 2012 storm is replayed as if it hit the Moon
p13_label_counterfactual.result: Labelled. The real July 2012 storm, replayed as if it hit the Moon.
p13_label_counterfactual.hint: The storm date is real. The Moon trip and game score are made up.

p13_record_current_state.goal: Save today's supplies at the Mission Table
p13_record_current_state.why: This storm uses the base as it is today
p13_record_current_state.result: Starting supplies saved before the storm.
p13_record_current_state.hint: Use today's numbers. Do not copy April's ending.

p13_confirm_five_person_profile.goal: Check five-person needs at the response controls
p13_confirm_five_person_profile.why: With Ferreira, the base needs more air and food
p13_confirm_five_person_profile.result: Air and food needs for five people are checked.
p13_confirm_five_person_profile.hint: Compare today's crew list with the old four-person card.

p13_confirm_shelter_roster.goal: Check five names on the shelter diagram
p13_confirm_shelter_roster.why: Everyone on the Moon needs a sure place in the shelter
p13_confirm_shelter_roster.result: All five names are on the shelter crew list.
p13_confirm_shelter_roster.hint: Read the names, not only the number of places.

p13_confirm_shared_resources.goal: Compare water needs at the response controls
p13_confirm_shared_resources.why: The shelter wall and the garden share the same stored water
p13_confirm_shared_resources.result: Shared water and supply limits compared in one plan.
p13_confirm_shared_resources.hint: Follow the borrowed water in both the shelter and garden plans.

p13_commit_plan.goal: Lock in the plan at the forecast table
p13_commit_plan.why: Crew, crops and founder seeds need one plan that works
p13_commit_plan.result: Six-step storm plan locked in. Crew, garden and seeds all covered.
p13_commit_plan.hint: Check shielding, heat, light and water return across the whole storm.

p13_latch_founder_reserve.goal: Latch the founder case inside the shelter
p13_latch_founder_reserve.why: Thirty original seeds must be sealed in a protected place
p13_latch_founder_reserve.result: Both parts of the founder case latched. Thirty seeds stay protected.
p13_latch_founder_reserve.hint: Match both seals to the founder seed record.

p13_verify_water_shield.goal: Check the water wall at the valve diagram
p13_verify_water_shield.why: Water in the wall blocks radiation, the storm's fast harmful particles
p13_verify_water_shield.result: Shelter water shielding matches the forecast.
p13_verify_water_shield.hint: Read the wall water for each exposure before the water goes back.

p13_verify_crate_shield.goal: Check supply shielding at the bundle rail
p13_verify_crate_shield.why: Water and stacked supplies share the shielding job
p13_verify_crate_shield.result: Supply shielding checked. It stays until the last exposure.
p13_verify_crate_shield.hint: Compare the stacked bundles with this plan, not April's plan.

p13_verify_drain_order.goal: Check water return at the valve diagram
p13_verify_drain_order.why: Draining too early leaves the crew less shielded later
p13_verify_drain_order.result: Water goes back only after the last exposure. Order checked.
p13_verify_drain_order.hint: Follow the order shown. Exposure check first, then water return.

p14_confirm_five_occupants.goal: Check five people inside the shelter
p14_confirm_five_occupants.why: Hear each person answer. An icon is not proof
p14_confirm_five_occupants.result: All five people answered by name.
p14_confirm_five_occupants.hint: Match each person's answer with their place in the shelter.

p14_check_hatch_one.goal: Check the inner hatch inside the shelter
p14_check_hatch_one.why: A closed hatch keeps the shelter's air in
p14_check_hatch_one.hint: Compare the closed light with the shelter steps.

p14_check_hatch_two.goal: Check the hatch again inside the shelter
p14_check_hatch_two.why: Two checks that agree keep the shelter safe
p14_check_hatch_two.result: Second hatch check agrees with the first.
p14_check_hatch_two.hint: Read the second check itself. Do not copy the first light.

p14_commit_steps_1_2.goal: Run the first wave at the local readings
p14_commit_steps_1_2.why: The real numbers must match the plan you checked
p14_commit_steps_1_2.result: First wave over. Steps one and two went as planned.
p14_commit_steps_1_2.hint: Compare each finished step with its forecast before you go on.

p14_save_forecast_comparison.goal: Compare the first wave at the forecast table
p14_save_forecast_comparison.why: A forecast only helps beside the real readings
p14_save_forecast_comparison.result: First-wave forecast and real readings saved side by side.
p14_save_forecast_comparison.hint: Keep the forecast numbers and real numbers side by side.

p14_confirm_case_sealed.goal: Check the seed case inside the shelter
p14_confirm_case_sealed.why: The founder seeds must stay protected through every wave
p14_confirm_case_sealed.result: Founder case is still sealed after the first wave.
p14_confirm_case_sealed.hint: Check both seals against the founder seed record.

p14_read_final_log.goal: Play the stored log inside the shelter
p14_read_final_log.why: In the quiet between waves, an old log plays from local storage
p14_read_final_log.result: Noor's last old log played from local storage.
p14_read_final_log.hint: Read the archive date and label before you decide what it means.

p14_record_academy_name.goal: Save the Academy's story at the forecast table
p14_record_academy_name.why: The log is the last piece of proof for the name
p14_record_academy_name.result: Alo's name and how the Academy began are saved from the log.
p14_record_academy_name.hint: Join the log with the packet and the signed page.

p14_save_progress_report.goal: Save the report at the forecast table
p14_save_progress_report.why: The report says what you know here and what Earth cannot hear
