p14_save_progress_report.result: Report saved here. Earth cannot hear it until the storm passes.
p14_save_progress_report.hint: Write what you can see and measure inside the shelter.

p14_commit_steps_3_6.goal: Run the last waves at the local readings
p14_commit_steps_3_6.why: At the peak, shielding must protect the crew and the crops
p14_commit_steps_3_6.result: Storm over. All six steps done, everyone safe.
p14_commit_steps_3_6.hint: Follow the plan to the last exposure, then return the water.

p14_confirm_crops_safe.goal: Check the living crops at the local readings
p14_confirm_crops_safe.why: Measure the garden to know it lived through the storm
p14_confirm_crops_safe.result: Living crops checked safe after all six storm steps.
p14_confirm_crops_safe.hint: Read the garden readings. Keep the garden sealed.

p14_confirm_reserve_30.goal: Check the founder seeds in the reserve case
p14_confirm_reserve_30.why: Thirty original seeds must live on, apart from working seeds
p14_confirm_reserve_30.result: Founder seeds checked. Thirty protected seeds still sealed.
p14_confirm_reserve_30.hint: Read the founder record, not the vault or working-seed pages.

p14_diagnose_external_branch.goal: Find the radio fault at the network diagnostic
p14_diagnose_external_branch.why: Local radio works, so the fault is on the Earth path
p14_diagnose_external_branch.result: Found it. The outside Earth antenna line failed. Local radio still works.
p14_diagnose_external_branch.hint: Compare the three test results: local, dish and wall joint.

p14_route_reading_1.goal: Read outside radiation at the Earth screen
p14_route_reading_1.why: Two safe readings are needed before anyone goes outside
p14_route_reading_1.result: First outside reading is below the safe line. One more needed.
p14_route_reading_1.hint: Compare the reading with the route limit on the screen.

p14_route_reading_2.goal: Read outside radiation again, ten minutes later
p14_route_reading_2.why: One safe reading is not enough to go outside
p14_route_reading_2.result: Second reading, ten minutes later, is also safe. The route is clear.
p14_route_reading_2.hint: Check the new reading and its time against the first.

p14_reconcile_local_stability.goal: Check the base at the Earth screen
p14_reconcile_local_stability.why: The base must keep working through weeks without Earth
p14_reconcile_local_stability.result: The base can run safely on its own while Earth is silent.
p14_reconcile_local_stability.hint: Use the crew's skills and stored steps. Earth cannot reply.

p14_reconcile_supplies.goal: Check supplies at the care-planning desk
p14_reconcile_supplies.why: Food and repairs must last through the weeks ahead
p14_reconcile_supplies.result: Dated supplies and daily use now match.
p14_reconcile_supplies.hint: Follow the dated supply record. Do not reuse an old night's numbers.

p14_date_march_gate.goal: Read the March notes at the Earth screen
p14_date_march_gate.why: The next job needs a clear date
p14_date_march_gate.result: Weeks pass safely. It is March. Time to fix the link.
p14_date_march_gate.hint: Read the dated care and supply notes before you go on.

p14_pack_controller.goal: Pack the controller at the fabrication bench
p14_pack_controller.why: The December spare can replace the broken relay controller
p14_pack_controller.result: December controller packed with its repair diagram. It fits.
p14_pack_controller.hint: Compare its serial number and plug with the relay housing.

p14_pack_battery.goal: Pack the battery at the fabrication bench
p14_pack_battery.why: A failed road repeater needs a spare battery that fits
p14_pack_battery.result: Spare repeater battery checked and packed.
p14_pack_battery.hint: Check it against the road repeater's repair record.

p14_pack_three_site_route.goal: Plan the route at the route simulator
p14_pack_three_site_route.why: Hills block radio, so repeaters must pass the signal on
p14_pack_three_site_route.result: Three repeater stops planned along the safe road.
p14_pack_three_site_route.hint: Join each repeater to the next one, around the hills.

p14_bench_test.goal: Test the equipment at the fabrication bench
p14_bench_test.why: A plan on paper still needs a real equipment test
p14_bench_test.result: Bench test passed. The trip is set for April.
p14_bench_test.hint: This is a bench test. The road tests come later.

p14_assign_field_team.goal: Choose the travellers at the rover departure board
p14_assign_field_team.why: Three seats need three named people, each with a job
p14_assign_field_team.result: Ferreira, Kai and Rafi will ride the rover.
p14_assign_field_team.hint: Match each traveller to a seat and a job.

p14_assign_home_team.goal: Choose the home crew at the departure board
p14_assign_home_team.why: Aurora needs two cadets to keep its living systems running
p14_assign_home_team.result: Mei and Amara will stay at Aurora.
p14_assign_home_team.hint: Check no name is in both places at once.

p14_sign_departure_prep.goal: Sign the plan at the rover loadout
p14_sign_departure_prep.why: Supplies must cover the travellers and the crew at home
p14_sign_departure_prep.result: Plan signed. Three travel at midnight, two keep Aurora running.
p14_sign_departure_prep.hint: Count the way out, the repair and the way home.

p15_confirm_teams.goal: Check team names at the rover bay
p15_confirm_teams.why: The rover and the habitat both need a crew
p15_confirm_teams.result: Three rover travellers and two home cadets checked.
p15_confirm_teams.hint: Compare each name with where that person should be.

p15_confirm_loadout.goal: Check the packing at the rover bay
p15_confirm_loadout.why: A far-away repair needs its tools and the right spares
p15_confirm_loadout.result: Controller, battery, repair diagram and repeater gear all checked.
p15_confirm_loadout.hint: Compare the packed things with the signed plan.

p15_confirm_roundtrip_provisions.goal: Check travel supplies at the rover bay
p15_confirm_roundtrip_provisions.why: The rover's own supplies must last the whole trip
p15_confirm_roundtrip_provisions.hint: Count the way out, the way home and the repair time.

p15_choose_surveyed_route.goal: Choose the road at the rover console
p15_choose_surveyed_route.why: A shortcut that looks cheap can be too steep
p15_choose_surveyed_route.result: Safe road chosen. Gentle enough, with battery to come home.
p15_choose_surveyed_route.hint: Compare the steepest slope as well as the travel cost.

p15_confirm_return_reserve.goal: Check return power at the rover console
p15_confirm_return_reserve.why: Reaching Malapert is only halfway home
p15_confirm_return_reserve.result: Battery covers the whole trip, out and back.
p15_confirm_return_reserve.hint: Take away the way out and way home, then see what is left.

p15_reach_marker_two.goal: Go to marker two on the surveyed road
p15_reach_marker_two.why: Marker two's repeater is dark. Stop at its service pad
p15_reach_marker_two.result: You are at the marker-two service pad.
p15_reach_marker_two.hint: Match the map marker with your direction reading, not only the sky.

p15_set_brake.goal: Put on the brake at marker two
p15_set_brake.why: Nobody works outside until the rover cannot roll
p15_set_brake.result: Rover brake is on at the marker-two service pad.
p15_set_brake.hint: Read the brake light before you get ready to go outside.

p15_save_position_packet.goal: Send your position from marker two
p15_save_position_packet.why: The home team needs fresh news of where you are
p15_save_position_packet.result: Position sent, so Aurora knows where you are.
p15_save_position_packet.hint: Check the sender, the place and the time before you send.

p15_restore_marker_2.goal: Fix the repeater at marker two
p15_restore_marker_2.why: This repeater passes the radio signal along the road
p15_restore_marker_2.result: Battery replaced. Marker two's repeater is working again.
p15_restore_marker_2.hint: Follow the repair drawing. Close it up before you connect power.

p15_test_repeater_chain.goal: Test both links at the repeater pad
p15_test_repeater_chain.why: A light that is on does not prove the radio works
p15_test_repeater_chain.result: All three repeaters link up. The road can carry a voice.
p15_test_repeater_chain.hint: Test the link each way. The power light is not enough.

p15_reach_approach.goal: Go to the approach on the surveyed road
p15_reach_approach.why: Check in here before the last part of the drive
p15_reach_approach.result: The rover team is at the approach. Local links are checked.
p15_reach_approach.hint: Keep the time and road position with your update.

p15_confirm_home_occupancy.goal: Check who is home at the home-loop panel
p15_confirm_home_occupancy.why: Two people breathe at home until the travellers return
p15_confirm_home_occupancy.result: Two at home. Mei and Amara hold Aurora through the night.
p15_confirm_home_occupancy.hint: Compare the home crew list with the rover's list.

p15_confirm_segment_forecast.goal: Try the home forecast at the home-loop panel
p15_confirm_segment_forecast.why: Later tonight, more people will be home to breathe the air
p15_confirm_segment_forecast.result: Forecast tried. Air and power last until the travellers return. Nothing spent.
p15_confirm_segment_forecast.hint: Count two people first, then all five for the last part.

p15_confirm_home_pressure.goal: Check home pressure at the garden probe
p15_confirm_home_pressure.why: Pressure is the push of the air. Measure it at home
p15_confirm_home_pressure.result: Aurora's pressure and home-loop checks are good.
p15_confirm_home_pressure.hint: Read the gauge, then heat, dim lamps and the return path.

p15_confirm_summit.goal: Check the summit arrival at the Earth screen
p15_confirm_summit.why: The travellers report in. Note where and when they arrived
p15_confirm_summit.result: Summit arrival checked, with its date and time.
p15_confirm_summit.hint: Compare the place and time now with the approach message.

p15_confirm_home_checks.goal: Do the home checks at the care-planning desk
p15_confirm_home_checks.why: A working radio does not keep Aurora's air and heat running
p15_confirm_home_checks.result: Aurora's home checks done and sent along the local chain.
p15_confirm_home_checks.hint: Read the newest home reading before you accept the rover team's news.

p15_receive_summit_packet.goal: Check the summit message at the Earth screen
p15_receive_summit_packet.why: An old position could send the other team wrong
p15_receive_summit_packet.result: Fresh summit message received through the checked local chain.
p15_receive_summit_packet.hint: Compare the message's time and place with an older saved position.

p16_isolate_power.goal: Shut off power at the relay service bay
p16_isolate_power.why: Work on the controller is only safe with the power off
p16_isolate_power.result: Relay controller power is shut off.
p16_isolate_power.hint: Read the repair diagram before you touch the housing.

p16_zero_test.goal: Check for zero power at the controller housing
p16_zero_test.why: A switch can lie. Measure that the power is really off
p16_zero_test.result: No power in the housing. Safe to work.
p16_zero_test.hint: Read the meter after the shut-off. Do not trust the switch.

p16_install_controller.goal: Put the new controller in the relay housing
p16_install_controller.why: The damaged part needs the stored spare that fits
p16_install_controller.result: New controller that fits is in the checked housing.
p16_install_controller.hint: Match the plugs and serial numbers with the repair record.

p16_close_housing.goal: Close the housing at the relay bay
p16_close_housing.why: Power must stay off until the cover is closed
p16_close_housing.result: Relay controller housing closed and checked.
p16_close_housing.hint: Read the closed light before you turn the power on.

p16_restore_power.goal: Turn on power at the relay service bay
p16_restore_power.why: The closed new part needs a careful power test
p16_restore_power.result: Power is back on in the closed controller housing.
p16_restore_power.hint: Check the zero-power and closed records before you turn it on.

p16_local_bearing.goal: Turn the local antenna at the summit
p16_local_bearing.why: Aurora needs its own clear radio path across the ground
p16_local_bearing.result: Local antenna points down the road towards Aurora.
p16_local_bearing.hint: Watch the signal light and the blocked light on the local path.

p16_earth_bearing.goal: Turn the Earth dish at the summit
p16_earth_bearing.why: The Earth path must pass its own test
p16_earth_bearing.result: Earth dish points at Earth, on its own path.
p16_earth_bearing.hint: Use the Earth-path lights. Do not reuse the local antenna result.

p16_stable_lock.goal: Check both links at the safety code terminal
p16_stable_lock.why: A short strong signal does not prove a steady link
p16_stable_lock.result: Local and Earth links are each locked and steady.
p16_stable_lock.hint: Wait for both links to stay steady. Using help counts too.

p16_checksum.goal: Check the echo at the safety code terminal
p16_checksum.why: The safety code shows if a message changed on the way
p16_checksum.result: The test phrase came back exactly. Nothing was lost.
p16_checksum.hint: Compare every letter that came back, and the message time.

p16_confirm_path_records.goal: Save both link records at the terminal
p16_confirm_path_records.why: Each radio path needs its own fresh proof
p16_confirm_path_records.result: Local and Earth path records are each saved.
p16_confirm_path_records.hint: Check each record is from this test, not an old message.

p16_voice_verification_ready.why: A data echo is not the same as a real talk
p16_voice_verification_ready.result: Both links ready. Time to hear real voices.
p16_voice_verification_ready.hint: Read the voice checks that are left after the data test.

p16_noor_live_voice.goal: Hear the live call at the Earth screen
p16_noor_live_voice.why: The link is fixed. Earth can finally hear Aurora
p16_noor_live_voice.result: Aurora and Earth voice checks passed. Noor's first live call is done.
p16_noor_live_voice.hint: Hear a voice answer on each path before you call the link done.

p16_confirm_telemetry.goal: Check the readings at the care-planning desk
p16_confirm_telemetry.why: The link must carry data as well as voices
p16_confirm_telemetry.result: Fresh readings received across the checked route.
p16_confirm_telemetry.hint: Compare the new readings with the voice check records.

p16_start_return.goal: Save the team's return at the care-planning desk
p16_start_return.why: The rover team still has to get home
p16_start_return.result: The travellers start home at 03:00. Twenty-four hours on the road.
p16_start_return.hint: Check the road home and the spare supplies before they leave.

p16_confirm_return_24h.goal: Check the return at the handover console
p16_confirm_return_24h.why: The trip is not over until the twenty-four hours home
p16_confirm_return_24h.result: Twenty-four-hour return done, with the route and supplies checked.
p16_confirm_return_24h.hint: Compare the times on the way home with the forecast.

p16_confirm_five_at_aurora.goal: Check five names at the departure boards
p16_confirm_five_at_aurora.why: Every traveller must really be home
p16_confirm_five_at_aurora.result: All five crew are at Aurora after the return.
p16_confirm_five_at_aurora.hint: Match each returning answer to the home crew list.

p16_update_occupancy.goal: Change the home count to five
p16_update_occupancy.why: The last three night hours must keep all five people alive
p16_update_occupancy.result: Home count for the last three hours is now five.
p16_update_occupancy.hint: Use the real arrival time when you change the home record.

p16_save_final_records.goal: Check final records at the home-loop panel
p16_save_final_records.why: Living crops and stored seeds each need their own check
p16_save_final_records.result: All safe. Five crew, thirty founder seeds, eleven vault seeds, living cotton.
p16_save_final_records.hint: Read every last safety record before you open the viewing shutter.

p16_save_photo.goal: Take the photo at the first-light board
p16_save_photo.why: Dawn shows the garden the crew kept alive
p16_save_photo.result: Garden photograph saved, with the living new plants and cotton.
p16_save_photo.hint: Archived Alo and Tara are not the living garden. Label them apart.

p16_save_dedication.goal: Choose a dedication at the plaque
p16_save_dedication.why: The crew can say what its shared work means
p16_save_dedication.result: Your garden dedication is saved beside the family record.
p16_save_dedication.hint: Pick the one you like. It does not change the science record.

p16_make_credits_available.goal: Open the credits at the photo board
p16_make_credits_available.why: The finished journey thanks its people and sources
p16_make_credits_available.result: The story is complete. Thank you, gardener.
p16_make_credits_available.hint: Look over the shared record when you are ready to finish.
